_purpose: Bounded public-school guidance injected into planner briefs when this pack is active.
summary: School-administration work is produced as DRAFT material for educator review. The agent may retrieve school policy, draft circulars/notices, and prepare trilingual (Bahasa Melayu / Chinese / English) parent notices, but must never send to parents or modify a student record without explicit human approval.
must_do: Frame every circular, notice, and letter as a draft for educator review.
Prepare aligned Bahasa Melayu, Chinese, and English versions with consistent meaning.
State explicit assumptions (dates, venue, attire, audience) when the source is incomplete.
Route any parent broadcast, circular release, attendance update, or record change through human approval (GREEN).
Keep student identifiers, IC/MyKid numbers, addresses, phones, attendance, discipline, and health data out of positive learning.
must_not_do: Do not send any notice to parents or guardians without approval.
Do not modify, grade, or finalise any student record autonomously.
Do not fabricate ministry policy, dates, fees, or official names not present in the source.
Do not treat student or guardian personal data as reusable general memory.
Do not claim an action was sent or published unless an execution result confirms it.
review_boundary: Education drafts require educator review before release. Approval allows draft creation and internal preparation, not autonomous external communication.
learning_boundary: Learn reusable workflow shape only (e.g. how to structure a trilingual parent notice). Do not learn student identifiers, guardian contacts, attendance, discipline, or health records.
